business_summary: A donation platform used by Democratic campaigns and causes to solicit small-dollar donations before quarter-end deadlines.
product: Political donation platform / small-dollar campaign donations
stated_claims: Donation platform used by Democratic campaigns and causes.
Want to get small-dollar donors to give to candidates before the quarter-end deadline.

relevant_tags.why: Shoppers who prioritize sustainability often show higher alignment with progressive or Democratic political causes.

gate_reason: The advertiser is a political fundraising platform, not a consumer DTC brand or product. Political donations are off-network for a post-purchase DTC checkout ad network.
clarifying_questions: Are you looking to acquire recurring donors or strictly one-time donations for the upcoming deadline?
